title: Extremely Overpriced
text:
Extremely Overpriced. As of this writing, these pants hangers are approximately $6 per hanger. I say the value just isn't there with these hangers to justify this price.

They do their job as far as holding the pants and keeping them from slipping out. I wish I had done more searching at Amazon where I just saw an almost exact design for a lot less money.
